answer: Triangulate where each agent actually runs. Every epoch, beacons on several continents ping identities at random moments, and the round-trip latencies plot each one as a saffron pin on a public map. Latency can be padded but never shortened, so a thousand clones on one rack collapse onto a single pin and split one vote. To scatter the pins an attacker must rent hosts in truly distinct regions, a cost rising with every fake, so a tide of cheap accounts still counts as one tree, not an orchard.
